role: Java / Vue / turning ideas into small things that actually run
paragraphs: Java is my day job, Vue my frontend. This site is the most recent side project: the interface was drawn from scratch and rebuilt one-to-one in Astro, and the service counting likes and reads is a Go binary I wrote myself.

Most posts are records of the process rather than conclusions. I'm not great at long-term plans, but I am good at spotting a more interesting detour halfway through. If you're building something similar, write to me.
